title: Malaysian Creme Pancake
description: A unique twist on traditional pancakes, using malaysian ingredients and topped with a tangy creme fraiche.

ingredients.name: malaysian crepe flour
ingredients.notes: available at most asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: caramelized malaysian pancake
ingredients.notes: available at most asian grocery stores

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the malaysian crepe flour, coconut milk, eggs, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Mix until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles form on the surface.
Flip and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve warm with caramelized malaysian pancake, creme fraiche, and honey if desired.
